plugins.name: DFT-relaxed crystal structures
plugins.description: Relaxed structures from Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, Alexandria and OQMD, symmetry-analysed with spglib, benchmarked against experimental COD structures, with CIF/POSCAR downloads, Robocrystallographer descriptions and Crystal-GENUI coordination polyhedra.

plugins.name: Tutorials & learning paths
plugins.description: Curated reviews, courses, books, software documentation and databases, chosen for experimentalists working on thermoelectric and topological materials. Bibliographic data comes from Crossref.

plugins.name: Knowledge graph & ontology
plugins.description: A small OWL/SKOS ontology linking materials, families, space groups, topological phases, operating regimes, coordination motifs, databases and literature. Downloadable as JSON-LD and Turtle.

plugins.name: Experimental zT(T) curves
plugins.description: Digitised temperature-dependent zT, Seebeck, conductivity and thermal-conductivity data with sample descriptors, e.g. from the Starrydata project.

plugins.name: Surface states & ARPES
plugins.description: Topological invariants from Topological Quantum Chemistry, plus links to published ARPES spectra and surface-state Fermi-velocity data.

plugins.name: Synthesis recipes
plugins.description: Crystal growth and densification routes (Bridgman, flux, ball-milling + SPS, MBE) with conditions extracted from the literature.
